Definition: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
BiblicalUsage: One is the first number and the simplest word, but the Bible loads it with weight. The first day is called one day, a man leaves his father and mother and becomes one flesh with his wife, and Israel confesses that the Lord our God is one Lord. Zechariah looks ahead to a day when the Lord will be one and His name one, the same unity spread over the whole earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the oneness of God is the foundation of everything, because one Lord means one truth, one way, and one people gathered under Him. My position is that unity among God's people is not a preference; it flows from who He is.
